==Overview==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Mythic}} {{LU}}. She is only obtainable by evolving [[Weather Girl]].

==Passive: Treasure Thief==
Upon placement, {{PAGENAME}} will mark an enemy (one per placement, so up to 3 per round) with a Beli symbol. Upon killing the enemy in question mark, the player will receive additional gold. Bonus gold amount increases with levels.
*Deployment: {{Yen|300}}
*Upgrade 1: {{Yen|450}}
*Upgrade 2: {{Yen|600}}
*Upgrade 3: {{Yen|800}}
*Upgrade 4: {{Yen|1,000}}
*Upgrade 5: {{Yen|1,500}}
*Upgrade 6: {{Yen|2,000}}
*Upgrade 7: {{Yen|2,500}}
*Upgrade 8: {{Yen|3,000}}
